_how_to_add: Add a new object at the TOP of the 'entries' list. Fields: date (YYYY-MM-DD), title, tag (New | Improved | Fixed), changes (list of lines). Save and push; the page updates by itself.

entries.title: Chemistry, seen-question tracking and multi-subject tests
changes: Added the Chemistry question bank with Physical, Inorganic and Organic chapter groups.
Pick Physics, Chemistry or both in one test.
Questions you have already seen are remembered and new ones are shown first (with a Reset button).
Chemistry questions without an answer key are hidden for now.

entries.title: TCS-style exam interface
changes: New exam screen modelled on the real CBT, with Light and Dark themes under Accessibility.
Bigger question images and preview, with no width cap.
Answers are saved only on Save & Next; the palette stays red until saved, then turns green.
Right-click is blocked on the test screen.
